children.help: Display Mode, Display Mode pop-up menu. Switch the Display and the ruler display between bars and beats, or hours, minutes and seconds.
children.title: Beats & Project

children.help: Playhead Position (Bars), Beats Position display. Indicates the playhead position in bars, beats, divisions and ticks. Edit numbers by dragging vertically or by double-clicking and entering a new value.
Tempo, Tempo display. Indicates the playback or recording speed. Drag vertically to speed up or slow down the tempo, or double-click and enter a new value.
Time Signature, Time Signature display. Indicates the number of beats in a bar and the note value for one beat. Drag vertically to edit the value or double-click and enter a new value.
Key Signature, Key Signature display. Indicates the key signature of the project. Choose a major or minor key signature from the pop-up menu.
Cycle   C, Cycle button. Turn Cycle mode on or off. Use to repeatedly play, or record over, the project section within the yellow cycle area that appears in the ruler.
children.title: Cycle

children.help: Record   R, Record button. Record to the selected track or to multiple record-enabled tracks.
children.title: Record

children.help: Play   Space, Play button. Start playback from the playhead position, or from the left locator shown in the ruler when in Cycle mode.
children.title: Play

children.help: Stop   0, Stop button. Stop playback or recording. Click when stopped to move the playhead to the project start point, or to the left locator shown in the ruler when in Cycle mode.
children.title: Stop

children.help: Forward   ., Forward button. Move the playhead forward one bar.
children.title: Forward

children.help: Rewind   ,, Rewind button. Move the playhead back one bar.
children.title: Rewind

children.help: This control is disabled because there is no recording track., Tuner button. Open the Tuner, which you can use to tune instruments connected to your computer.
children.title: Tuner

children.help: Count In   ⇧K, Count-in button. Toggle the count-in before recording starts. To define the count-in, choose Record > Count-in.
children.title: Count In

children.help: Metronome Click   K, Metronome button. Hear a click at the project tempo during playback and recording.
children.title: Metronome Click

children.help: Library   Y, Library button. Open the Library to view and select patches for the selected track type.
children.title: Library

children.help: Quick Help button. Show or hide Quick Help. When activated and the pointer is over the Quick Help button, Coaching Tips for the main working areas are shown.
children.title: Quick Help

children.help: Smart Controls   B, Smart Controls button. Open the Smart Controls area, where you can quickly modify the sound of the current patch.
children.title: Smart Controls

children.help: Editors   E, Editors button. Open an editor for the selected track type (Audio, Piano Roll, Score or Drummer Editor).
children.title: Editors

children.help: Notepad   ⌃⇧P, Notepad button. Open the Notepad, where you can create, view and edit project text notes.
children.title: Notepad

children.help: Loop Browser   O, Loop Browser button. Open the Loop Browser, which contains pre-recorded audio, MIDI and Drummer loops you can add to your project.
children.title: Loop Browser

children.help: Master Volume
